candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: Strong identity and action; stone and cloth microtexture push ordinary panels toward moderate density.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: Clearest phone silhouettes, strongest value grouping, mature faces, restrained flat shapes, and decisive ember motion wedges.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Appealing faces but luminous gradients and environmental finish converge toward the generic painterly failure profile.
